title: agentd Event Envelope v1
description: Machine-usable schema for events published to agent.events.<agent_id>. agentd interprets only version, event_id and agent_id; every other field passes through to the handler unchanged, and unknown fields are accepted (forward compatibility).

version.description: Envelope version. Only 1 is accepted; any other value is terminally dropped.

event_id.description: Globally unique, stable identifier (UUIDv7 / ULID recommended). Used for best-effort deduplication; encodes no ordering.

agent_id.description: Target agent. Underscore-separated tokens; also the subject tail (agent.events.<agent_id>), consumer name (agent-<agent_id>) and config filename (<agent_id>.toml).

type.description: Event type hint (e.g. im.message, ci.completed). agentd does not interpret it.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp from the sender. agentd does not interpret it.

payload.description: Any JSON value. Passed through unmodified; total envelope size capped by max_event_bytes (default 256 KiB).

metadata.description: Optional pass-through object: sender claims, signatures, reply targets, trace context. Handlers own all interpretation.
